stemBlocks: In the disease emphysema the walls of the alveoli break down so that several smaller alveoli fuse to form a single large alveolus. The diagram shows a model of the effect of emphysema on spherical alveoli.
Which of the following statements is/are correct?
1 The surface area-to-volume ratio of the four healthy alveoli is twice that of the single emphysema alveolus.
2 For the same concentration gradient, the rate of diffusion of oxygen into the blood from a single healthy alveolus will be greater than for a single emphysema alveolus.
3 Oxygen molecules will only move across the alveolus wall from the inside to the outside of an alveolus.
(surface area of a sphere = $4\pi r^2$; volume of a sphere = $\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3$, where $r$ is the radius)
